newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee little changed against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee little changed against dollar.

text.p: The Mauritius rupee was little changed against the dollar on Monday, reflecting a stable international forex market, dealers said.
The rupee was posted at a mean rate of 20.4295 against the dollar from 20.4265 last Thursday. Against the pound, the rupee traded at a mean rate of 33.4235 from 33.3440 on Thursday.
There was no forex dealing on Friday because of a public holiday.
Forex dealers said the rupee's fixing was in line with overnight international trends where the dollar was trading in tight ranges.
"Banks are presently square in their foreign exchange reserves after regular interventions by the central bank last week. This has stabilised the rupee," one dealer said.

The central bank was seen selling dollars to the interbank forex market on Monday and Wednesday last week at rates slightly below the prevailing interbank rates. This sustained the rupee's exchange rate against foreign currencies.
